changelog: v0.35.0: Share clips as full .rp3 files with a proper message template; Shared With Me inbox for received clips with Add to Vault and Delete actions; mic auto-pauses while editing notes so keyboard dictation works; full Android Auto media support with browse tree and Snip button

v0.29.44: Fixed microphone/playback coupling by disabling player audio-focus pausing during always-listening startup and hardening recognizer restart/backoff logic, expanded triple-tap override detection with a wider timing window and less restrictive seek/transition fallback for Bose-style headset event patterns while preserving default single/double behavior, and reduced launcher icon foreground scale to match the provided artwork framing

v0.29.43: Restored active wake listening during audio playback by removing speaker-playback suppression, recovered Bluetooth triple-tap routing by restoring media-session audio-focus ownership, changed tap handling so single/double previous/next stay immediate default behavior while only tap 3 is overridden to snip, and updated launcher/splash branding with the new icon and logo assets

v0.29.42: Made the microphone independent from podcast playback, routed wake-phrase capture to normal recording when no podcast is active, stopped voice-trigger startup from pausing in-app playback, restored triple-tap override on previous/next seek keys, preserved default single/double earbud behavior, and published updated APK/AAB website surfaces

v0.29.41: Replaced MFCC/DTW voice matching with continuous SpeechRecognizer text matching for any-speaker always-listening detection, fixed microphone toggles re-enabling themselves after disable, fixed triple-tap taps 1 and 2 seeking the episode before tap 3 could snip, and published updated APK/AAB website surfaces
v0.29.39: Restored always-on triple-tap snip dispatch regardless of compatibility toggle, fixed post-capture voice cooldown reset to stop recording loops, and published updated website APK surfaces
v0.29.38: Hardened voice trigger against speaker bleed and loop retriggers, tightened keyword thresholds, and force-cancelled active snips immediately when playback stops

v0.29.38: Hardened voice trigger against speaker-audio false positives (speaker-route suppression without external mic), extended wake retrigger cooldown, tightened keyword thresholding, and force-cancelled active snips immediately when playback is stopped
v0.29.37: Rebuilt earbud handling to triple-only compatibility override, disabled compatibility mode by default on upgrade, and gated KDS startup to active playback to prevent idle settings crashes

v0.29.37: Rebuilt earbud handling to triple-only override in compatibility mode (single/double pass-through), removed non-compatible fallback remaps, playback-gated KDS startup to prevent idle settings crashes, and reset compatibility mode default to off on upgrade
v0.29.36: Triple-tap-only compatibility override, always-audible capture tones, and AEC hardening for speaker-mode wake detection

v0.29.36: Enforce triple-tap-only compatibility override, remove double-tap snip remapping, add post-triple input cooldown, restore always-audible start/finish snip tones, and add AEC hardening for speaker-mode wake detection
v0.29.35: Fix voice retraining/template rotation, improve wake sensitivity floor, harden compatibility triple-tap dispatch, and restore snip beep reliability

v0.29.35: Fix retraining template overwrite logic, relax adaptive wake threshold floor, align training/detection source preference, harden compatibility-mode snip dispatch during playback transitions, and add fallback beep stream routing

v0.29.30: Fix post-first-capture re-arm failures for voice and earbud triggers by using explicit capture completion signaling and restoring playback position when compatibility-mode headset gestures are intercepted
v0.29.29: Fix voice-trigger fallback beeps at 10s, fully override compatibility tap skip actions, enforce 3 calibration tests, and ensure splash logo uses 95% screen width
v0.29.28: Fixed triple-tap in compatibility mode recording unintentionally skipping to next episode by suppressing seek commands within 1000ms of snip dispatch
v0.29.28: Fixed voice calibration setup allowing only 2/3 passes by enforcing all 3 attempts and adding explicit pass counter guidance with improved error handling on 3rd attempt
v0.29.28: Added longer mic cleanup delays (1500ms and 3000ms) for 1st and 3rd calibration attempts to prevent OEM SpeechRecognizer rapid-access crashes
v0.29.28: Improved voice setup UI with attempt-specific guidance (final attempt prompt, pass count progress indicator, explicit continue button when ready to save)
v0.29.28: Fixed beep timing by removing second beep from onSnipStart() - now plays single beep at recording START and double beep at recording END only
v0.29.27: Restored VOICE_RECOGNITION-first wake source selection to match trained templates after Bluetooth route switches
v0.29.27: Fixed headset fallback regression where discontinuity/player-command events could incorrectly dispatch single-tap pause
v0.29.27: Compatibility mode now maps headset discontinuity seek events directly to snip with cooldown guard
v0.29.27: Strengthened snip beep audibility with higher minimum volume floor and reinforced start/stop tone playback
v0.29.27: Increased splash logo width to 95% of screen while preserving image aspect ratio
v0.29.26: Added automatic keyword engine restart when microphone input route changes (built-in, wired, USB, Bluetooth)
v0.29.26: Added temporary playback ducking during speech windows to improve wake-word detection at higher playback volumes
v0.29.26: Added discontinuity-based headset fallback so triple-tap-like seek bursts can still map to capture
v0.29.25: Increased capture beep loudness by 50% and lengthened tone duration for better audibility
v0.29.25: Added hard earbud compatibility fallback using media-item transition path when tap command callbacks are bypassed
v0.29.24: Added hard guard to prevent voice/tap snip triggers when app audio is not active
v0.29.24: Wake phrase detections now log explicit no-audio suppression reason for diagnostics
v0.29.23: Reduced false voice triggers with stricter multi-template DTW match gating and tighter adaptive threshold bounds
v0.29.23: Added 12-second wake-trigger cooldown to prevent repeated auto-captures from clustered ambient speech
v0.29.23: Restored explicit start beep/haptic for keyword-triggered capture path
v0.29.22: Improved wake phrase acceptance by increasing adaptive template threshold range for real playback environments
v0.29.22: Trimmed long detected utterances before matching to reduce podcast bleed and improve phrase isolation
v0.29.21: Added headset command fallback interception so triple-tap can be handled even when media button key events are suppressed by firmware
v0.29.21: Added adaptive keyword threshold from user templates to improve real-world wake phrase matching
v0.29.21: Reduced oversized utterance buffers and forced chunk evaluation to avoid long mixed-audio windows
v0.29.20: Fixed DTW matcher pathing for different utterance lengths (eliminates INF-style giant distance outputs)
v0.29.20: Improved speech segmentation stability during playback to reduce premature short utterances
v0.29.20: Added crash-safety guards around voice training recognizer/audio teardown and startup
v0.29.19: Fixed calibration flow to complete once 2 passes are confirmed so template recording reliably begins
v0.29.19: Improved wake-phrase pickup sensitivity (VAD + DTW threshold tuning) for quieter real-world speech
v0.29.19: Added diagnostics for speech onset/end and per-utterance DTW match results
v0.29.18: Added in-app diagnostics panel in Settings with a developer toggle and live runtime logs
v0.29.18: Fixed voice setup mic-start regression where calibration start was blocked after countdown
v0.29.18: Hardened earbud gesture handling with wider triple-tap timing to prevent accidental skip-next before tap 3
v0.29.18: Simplified voice source startup to deterministic fallback order (VOICE_RECOGNITION -> MIC -> UNPROCESSED)
v0.29.18: Updated splash branding with larger vault logo and new subtitle 'Build the brain'
v0.29.17: Rebuilt Bluetooth tap override from scratch - 1 tap pauses, 2 taps skips next, 3 taps records clip
v0.29.17: Triple-tap now firmware-agnostic - PLAY_PAUSE, NEXT, PREVIOUS, and HEADSETHOOK all count as tap events
v0.29.17: Fixed voice-trigger source routing - engine probes VOICE_RECOGNITION, MIC, and UNPROCESSED then auto-selects active microphone path
v0.29.17: Fixed voice setup crash on first install - added calibration re-entry guards and retry de-duplication
v0.29.17: Updated launch splash to vault-logo.png and aligned app palette to blue/gold brand colors
v0.29.16: Fixed voice trigger source mismatch and added CMS normalisation
v0.29.15: Fixed app crash during voice training and no mic permission dialog
v0.29.14: Fixed earbuds triple-tap regression
v0.29.13: Fixed podcast audio distortion with mic active
v0.29.10: Voice detection restart after training
v0.6.0: Internal ExoPlayer audio capture
v0.1.0: Initial release
